reuse.why: Instead of extracting and reusing the local-clearing part of the existing unlinkAccount, it rewrites the same db.updateAccount field reset inline.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset block is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the definition of an 'unlinked' account now lives in two places.

placement.why: A side-effecting unlink is put inside ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, a guard whose name and role are validation, so a check function now mutates another account before the link runs.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard and its six call sites plus tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Hidden mutation in a guard plus a copied reset block that can drift from unlinkAccount make this harder to own; a shared clearLocalBankLink helper called from both would be clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked re-does the db.updateAccount reset of unlinkAccount instead of going through a shared local-unlink helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block in ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked is an undisguised verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update.
